en.headline: Lo says public healthcare subsidy remains at 95 per cent
en.dek: The health secretary told lawmakers fee waivers have widened sharply, while accident and emergency visits in the first nine months edged down.
body: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said on Wednesday that, after the public healthcare fee changes, the government was still subsidising about 95 per cent of the cost of public medical services, and that patients' share remained very small.

In a written reply to the Legislative Council, Lo said the fee-waiver net had widened, with the potential number of people covered rising from about 900,000 to about 2 million. By 30 September the Hospital Authority had received 331,951 waiver applications and approved more than 300,000 of them, a rate above 90 per cent. Full waivers, previously fewer than 14,000 in a year, had risen to more than 250,000.

Accident and emergency attendances at the authority's 18 departments exceeded 1.4 million in the first nine months of the year, 0.9 per cent fewer than a year earlier. Semi-urgent and non-urgent cases, categories four and five, fell 6.8 per cent, and non-urgent cases alone fell 17.5 per cent. Critical and emergency patients are fully exempt from the accident and emergency charge. The share of category-three patients treated within 30 minutes rose from 82 per cent to 88.4 per cent, Lo said.

A yearly charge cap of 10,000 dollars, with no means test, had been granted to 20,655 patients by 30 September. Lo said extra fee income was partly offset by the wider waivers and the cap. Because the changes have been in place for less than a year, he said it was too early to judge their overall effect on the authority's finances.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：收費改革後公營醫療資助仍維持95%
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長回覆立法會，指費用減免覆蓋擴大，首九個月急症室求診人次按年微跌。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂周三表示，公營醫療收費改革實施後，政府對公營醫療服務的資助仍維持約95%，市民共付比例仍然很低。
他回覆立法會議員書面質詢時說，醫療費用減免的潛在受惠人數由約90萬人增至約200萬人。截至9月30日，醫管局接獲331,951宗減免申請，超過30萬宗獲批，批核率逾九成。獲全額減免的人數由以往全年少於1.4萬人增至超過25萬人。
今年首九個月，醫管局18間急症室錄得超過140萬人次應診，較去年同期減少0.9%。第四及第五類別，即次緊急及非緊急個案減少6.8%，非緊急個案減幅達17.5%。危殆及危急病人獲全數豁免急症室收費。第三類別個案在30分鐘內獲救治的比率由82%升至88.4%。
全年收費上限1萬元、毋須經濟審查的機制，截至9月30日已有20,655名病人獲批。盧寵茂說，加費帶來的收入部分被擴大的減免和收費上限抵消。改革實施未足一年，現階段難以全面評估對醫管局財政的整體影響。
